The spy

Setting

This meeting place belongs to Uncle Rad, the sweets seller who secretly serves the baron. A password from Stark opens a channel for intelligence and practical help, including the search for powerful allies outside the cities. [1, 2, 3, 4]

Return to Jigran and Dar-Leanos

The old portal brings the travellers to the Canian side of Jigran, where Baron Virril questions their arrival amid attacks by the undead. The baron has lost Dar-Ulgorn to Firez’s forces but refuses Kir’s suggestion to seek outside help, citing his family’s pride. Kir and Kel assist the endangered settlements. They meet the baron’s son Dartas and the overworked Master Stark. Stark provides a password for Uncle Rad, a seller of sweets who secretly gathers intelligence for the baron. These local alliances make the campaign against Firez possible. [5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 2, 10]

The confectioner’s intelligence network

Rad’s trade made him a spy. Children from households on both sides of Jigran visited his shop and repeated things they had heard; through them he learned that the Khadaganians were preparing to attack Dar-Ulgorn. He warned the baron in time to limit the losses. He continues supplying sweets to Firez’s household and listening to customers, using the ordinary movements of a confectioner as cover. He also directs Kir towards Jaminin on Death Island: fighting each risen corpse will not stop the source of the outbreak. [11, 12, 13]

The Joon cache and allies for the assault

The sealed cache supplies Kir with Joon armour, but Tui-Len warns him against relying on hatred alone. He gives him an amulet that can turn dangerous creatures into allies. Rad identifies suitable hunting grounds for a cyclops and a dragon. Their recruitment changes the military balance and answers the baron’s objection that his soldiers cannot face Firez’s necromancy in a direct assault. Virril finally orders the attack. Before the confrontation, Rad speaks of the quiet home and family he hopes to have when his secret work is finished. The cache is found in the valley Rad hopes to settle after the war. Dartas’s account of a nearby village destroyed by harpies points Kir to the rectangular amulet needed at its sealed entrance; Tui-Len supplies the remaining magical help. During the assault, Firez sends the city’s population, transformed into undead, against the Canian force. Kir must break through this army to reach the palace. [14, 3, 15, 4, 16, 17, 18, 19]
